name: Ergodex AI
long_description: Ergodex is a full-stack AI-native chip design company. We build environments that turn chip design tasks with measurable objectives into an implement → verify → score → optimize loop. Unlike traditional EDA, Ergodex can optimize not just the chip and the flow scripts, but also EDA algorithms used to design it. Our environments ship with FrontierEDA tools built for fast AI-driven iteration. We can achieve 100x faster Design Verification, and 50% faster convergence on PPA optimization.
